reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I have a drawer full of half-used bottles. I reorder my usual brand when it runs out, so I don't need to carry it anywhere.
objection: I don't have a problem this solves. Magnesium at home before bed works for me, and a new brand at $30 a month is just one more thing I'd stop taking.
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper per day than what I already buy, or if I traveled a lot and kept forgetting my bottle.
